text:
jess: Quick async check — where do we stand on the kernel perf milestones? Need the continuous-batching refactor merged by Wed EOD to hit the canary window.

omar: PR is open: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pulls/5123 — kernel batching refactor + kv cache hook. Tests failing in int/alloc path, looks like a race in kv warmup.

leila: I'll take the kv warmup race. Can reproduce locally with the small repro script Omar attached in the PR. ETA for a patch: today afternoon. @omar can you drop the repro here? :eyes:

omar: repro snippet attached in PR, but copying quick run here:
```
# repro (docker)
docker build -t kv-repro .
docker run --rm kv-repro pytest tests/test_warmup.py::test_race -k "slow"
```

leila: thanks — reproduced. Root cause is the eviction callback not waiting for pending batch flush. I'll add a small sync + metric to verify.

brian: FYI ops schedule — we reserved Thu 13:00-15:00 UTC for the canary. If batching PR slips past Wed EOD we should postpone canary. Don't want a surprise rollback during peak.

jess: understood. If Leila lands a fix today, can Omar re-run full int suite tonight and ping deploy-bot for a staging canary tomorrow? Also need a short note for product about potential 24h drift.

omar: yes — will run full int at ~22:00 PT and post results here. If green, I'll queue a canary deploy to staging and mark the PR with :shipit:.

sre-oncall: please add a runbook entry for the new warmup flow — quick checklist: how to detect kv warmup stalls, metric names, and how to abort canary. Putting placeholder at https://infra.redwood/runbooks/kv-warmup.

leila: adding metrics: runtime.kv.warmup.waits and runtime.kv.eviction.blocked. Will push alongside the fix.

omar: CI update — one flaky test unrelated to batching popped, will ignore for now and re-run job 3. If the kernel batch tests pass, I'll unblock.

deploy-bot: canary queued -> staging at 2024-11-14T22:30:00Z (triggered by omar). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/9876 :rocket:

jess: thanks all. Final asks: (1) Omar, drop the final int results here; (2) Leila, link the fix PR to the rollout ticket; (3) Brian, confirm ops standby for Thu. If any blockers, call out ASAP.

leila: will link fix -> TKT-4721 and ping once merged.

brian: ops confirmed standby Thu 13:00-15:00 UTC. I'll be oncall during the window.

omar: int run finished: all batching/kernel tests passed, 2 unrelated flakes re-run and cleared. Uploading artifacts now.

jess: perfect. I'm going to update the project board with new milestone dates and note the canary time. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
